commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: baseline boot id"
sudo -n cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id

echo "STEP: create appworker user"
if id appworker >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "appworker already exists"
else
  sudo -n useradd -m appworker
fi
id appworker

echo "STEP: write limits.d config"
sudo -n tee /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf >/dev/null <<'EOF'
appworker soft nofile 8192
appworker hard nofile 8192
appworker soft nproc 256
appworker hard nproc 256
EOF
cat /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf

echo "STEP: verify via su login shell (pam_limits applied)"
sudo -n su - appworker -c 'ulimit -n; ulimit -u'
